text:
maria: Hey team, we need a concrete spec for the new reliability dashboard showing fallbacks + error taxonomy (timeouts, 5xx, OOM, degraded-mode counts). Putting this on the plate for console + runtime telemetry alignment.

ajay: +1 — runtime can emit the signals but we need field names and label sets. quick ask: do we want per-route + per-model breakdowns or start coarser?

lee: SRE preference is per-route + region + deployment_mode (hosted/dedicated/private). That lets us triage noisy routes vs infra issues.

sarah: From product/PM: per-route + customer-tier would be ideal for rollout UX, but that's a later join. start with per-route + model + region and we can add customer-tier metadata later.

nina: DevEx note: console panels should offer a single "fallbacks" metric + stacked breakdown by reason (timeout, 5xx, oom, degraded). Also want a top-10 routes table.

maria: OK agree on labels: route, model, region, deployment_mode, pod_type (runtime/worker). ajay can you confirm we can emit those?

ajay: We can. Proposing metric names: runtime_request_fallback_total{route,model,region,deployment_mode,reason}, runtime_oom_total{route,model,region}, runtime_timeout_total{route,model,region}, http_response_total{route,model,region,code}. Degraded mode as a gauge: runtime_degraded_gauge{route} = 1 when degraded.

lee: Example alerting queries I'd run: 
```
# fallback rate by route (5m)
sum(rate(runtime_request_fallback_total[5m])) by (route)

# 5xx rate (5m)
sum(rate(http_response_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) by (route)

# OOM spikes
sum(increase(runtime_oom_total[5m])) by (route)
```

sarah: Can the runtime attach a reason label to fallbacks? e.g., reason="kv-cache-miss" vs "oom-fallback" vs "model-unavailable". That makes dashboard stackable.

ajay: Yep we have a short list of canonical reasons. We'll normalize to: timeout, http_5xx, oom, degraded_mode, capacity, model_error.

nina: Console UX: preview panel should include an explainer tooltip that maps reason -> recommended action (e.g., oom -> consider quantization/route to dedicated). Also want a per-route historical baseline (7d vs 30d).

maria: Good. Ownership: runtime (ajay) to add metrics + labels; eng-platform (maria) to design panel + API to fetch dimension filters; SRE (lee) to propose alerts and SLO targets; DevEx (nina) to wire tooltip content.

ajay: I'll push a PR that emits the new metrics with tags by EOD Wed. sample prom queries in PR.

lee: For alerts, propose paging thresholds: fallback rate > 5% sustained 10m for customer-facing routes; 5xx increase 3x baseline for 5m. We can iterate.

sarah: For rollout UX: if a route exceeds fallback threshold during a canary, console should show automatic suggestion: "pause rollout / route traffic to fallback model". Is that feasible?

ajay: We can emit an event to the control plane when fallback rate spikes and the console can surface that. The integration will need an API contract (event type + route id + metric snapshot).

nina: I'll draft the panel mock with a wire link and include a small JSON schema for the event.

maria: One more ask: can we tag fallbacks with request_origin (api/sdk/console) so product can see if devs are testing vs real traffic? keep as optional label to avoid high cardinality.

ajay: optional label is fine, we'll sample it for high-cardinality routes.

grafana-bot: New datasource: runtime-metrics.prom (connected). Will create a draft dashboard from queries in thread.

maria: Action items summary:
- ajay: implement metrics + reasons labels + sample queries (due Wed)
- maria: dashboard layout + panel spec + route table (due Fri)
- lee: alert rules draft + SLO suggestions (due Thu)
- nina: tooltip content + mock + event schema for console (due Fri)
- sarah: confirm product rollout messaging and customer-tier mapping (sync Tue)

lee: adding runbook link suggestion: https://runbooks/internal/runtime-fallbacks (we can update)

maria: If no objections I'll lock these labels/names and start the console PR once ajay's metrics land. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ajay: ack, will post the PR link here when ready.

sarah: thanks team — excited to have clearer visibility on fallbacks.

maria: closing thread for now, will reopen with PR links.
